crossRefs.note: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of…
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair…
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…

translations.web: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
translations.bsb: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
translations.kjv: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
translations.asv: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.
